verdict.rationale: GitLab's own materials state that it consolidates SAST, SCA (dependency scanning), Secret Detection and DAST into one platform. They say SAST runs "in every pipeline" and that findings surface directly in merge requests and IDEs, which covers both vulnerable dependencies and code security issues, run automatically. GitLab also uses Trivy as its default container scanning engine. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on configuring dependency/SAST scanning (the evidence is homepage marketing), and independent or hands-on corroboration of scan quality or coverage.
